title: 1.7: Record every platform on a page, not the first match
body:
<!-- gitissue:normalized v1 -->

## Type

bug (high confidence)

## Description

Change detectors to collect all matching platforms per scan without blowing the 100ms budget. Deduplicate observer vs delayed scan so a pixel in the first 3s is not stored twice.

**Current behavior:**
Change detectors to collect all matching platforms per scan without blowing the 100ms budget. Deduplicate observer vs delayed scan so a pixel in the first 3s is not stored twice.
